overview: This paper proposes Think-Then-Embed (TTE), a framework that enhances Universal Multimodal Embeddings by generating intermediate reasoning traces (ECR) before embedding, utilizing separate or unified reasoner-embedder architectures.

modules.name: ECR Generation & Prompting
modules.description: Module responsible for constructing task-specific prompt templates and interfacing with Multimodal LLMs (Teacher or Student) to generate Embedding-Centric Reasoning (ECR) traces, including intermediate Chain-of-Thought and final reasoning steps.

modules.name: Data Loader & Noisy Construction
modules.description: Dataset class for loading multimodal inputs and their corresponding ECR traces. Implements the 'noisy ECR' construction strategy—such as rephrasing ground truths and retaining ground truth in only a subset of samples—to prevent label leakage and improve embedder robustness.

modules.name: Reasoner Architecture
modules.description: Model wrapper for the MLLM acting as the reasoner. Supports inference modes for zero-shot ECR generation and training modes for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to distill a smaller student reasoner.

modules.name: Embedder Architecture (Separate)
modules.description: Model structure for the TTEt/TTEs settings. It concatenates visual tokens, text tokens, and ECR tokens as input to the MLLM and extracts the final representation using last-token pooling.

modules.name: Unified Architecture & Embedding Heads
modules.description: Model structure for the TTEu setting where a single backbone serves as both reasoner and embedder. Includes implementations for pluggable embedding heads (Simple Attention, NV-Embed-style, QFormer, Self-Initialized MHSA) that process the backbone's hidden states.

modules.name: Reasoner SFT Engine
modules.description: Training logic for fine-tuning the student reasoner. Implements the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) loss optimization using teacher-generated ECR traces as targets.

modules.name: Embedder Contrastive Engine
modules.description: Training logic for the embedder model (separate or unified). Implements the uni-directional query-to-target InfoNCE loss, integrates Gradient Caching (GradCache) for large batch simulation, and manages LoRA optimization for the backbone.

modules.name: Unified 2-Stage Training Engine
modules.description: Workflow controller for the unified model (TTEu). Manages the sequential execution of Stage 1 (fine-tuning the backbone as a reasoner) and Stage 2 (freezing the backbone and training the embedding head).

modules.name: Pooling & Representation Extraction
modules.description: Logic for aggregating MLLM hidden states into a single vector representation. Supports different extraction strategies (e.g., using the last token vs. intermediate layers) and handles the separation of reasoning and content tokens.

modules.name: Evaluation & Benchmarking
modules.description: Execution scripts for the MMEB-V1 and MMEB-V2 benchmarks. Calculates core metrics such as NDCG@5 for visual document retrieval and Precision@1 for image/video tasks.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configuration and execution logic for controlled experiments, including comparisons between zero-shot and finetuned reasoners, with vs. without intermediate CoT, Text-to-Text retrieval using ECR only, and the impact of varying teacher model capacities.

modules.name: Visualization & Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Module for generating t-SNE visualizations to compare query-target embedding distributions between baselines and TTE, as well as scripts for calculating parameter counts and inference latency to compare separate vs. unified architectures.
